Class Screen<S extends Screen<S>>

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.Screen<S>
Type Parameters:
S - the concrete screen type (self-bounded to enable fluent return types)
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventVisitor<S>
Direct Known Subclasses:
GUIScreen, TUIScreen
public abstract class Screen<S extends Screen<S>> extends Object implements EventVisitor<S>
Transport-independent base for a single game screen. Implements EventVisitor so incoming server events are directly dispatched via the visitor pattern: returning this keeps the current screen, returning a new instance triggers a transition.

Concrete screen hierarchies (TUIScreen, GUIScreen) extend this class and implement the factory methods to instantiate the correct concrete screen for each event type.

  • Method Details

    • isExit

      public boolean isExit()
      Sentinel flag for terminal screens. The TUI loop stops as soon as the current screen reports true; the GUI runs its shutdown sequence. Defaults to false; the ExitScreen variants override it. Lets the runtime detect the terminal state through polymorphism instead of a subtype check.
